payload.text: **gyges: exclude ~/Devel from Spotlight**, as on rhadamanth (hv, 26 Oct: "There is no need _at_all_ for Spotlight to index _anything_ under ~/Devel"). It's done by hand in System Settings › Spotlight › Search Privacy; no supported CLI does it without root, and `.metadata_never_index` markers are not honoured on this macOS. Do it when hv is next at gyges. Check with `mdfind -onlyin ~/Devel -count 'kMDItemContentTypeTree == "public.item"'`, which should read 0.
